description: A gray T-shirt lies on a yellow tabletop in front of a brown fabric backdrop. The right hand reaches in and lifts the shirt up from the center, then both hands spread it open and lay it flat; the left hand pulls the left side inward and the right hand folds the right side over to make a long rectangle, then both hands fold the top section down and press to flatten, ending with the shirt as a compact two-hand object before releasing.
